description: Mandate 18 evidence: customer SLOs, live NAT metrics, telemetry volume, and non-compute usage normalised to us-east-1 list price. CUR-backed panels are billing evidence and update daily; CloudWatch and Prometheus panels are live.

panels.title: 1. Customer SLOs — must remain healthy while cost is reduced

targets.expr: 100 * (1 - (sum(rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_count{service_name="frontend", span_name=~"render route.*|GET /products/.*|GET /api/products/.*", status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) / clamp_min(sum(rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_count{service_name="frontend", span_name=~"render route.*|GET /products/.*|GET /api/products/.*"}[$__rate_interval])), 0.000001))

panels.title: 2. Live Network Usage — NAT and Cross-AZ
NAT data processed by gateway
panels.description: Live AWS/NATGateway byte counters. Total data processed is BytesOutToDestination + BytesOutToSource, matching the Mandate 18 measurement script.

panels.title: Cross-AZ data transfer billing usage
panels.description: CUR records the charged cross-AZ usage type. It is daily billing evidence; the controlled 15-minute Flow Logs measurement remains the exact before/after proof.

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT line_item_usage_type AS usage_type, pricing_unit AS unit, SUM(CAST(line_item_usage_amount AS double)) AS usage_amount
FROM "${cur_database}"."${cur_table}"
WHERE line_item_line_item_type = 'Usage'
  AND line_item_usage_type LIKE '%DataTransfer-xAZ-%'
  AND $__timeFilter(line_item_usage_start_date)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 3 DESC

panels.title: 3. Storage, VPC Interface Endpoint and Telemetry Usage
EBS volume usage
panels.description: EBS billing usage in GB-month. gp3 is the expected volume type.

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT line_item_usage_type AS usage_type, pricing_unit AS unit, SUM(CAST(line_item_usage_amount AS double)) AS gb_month
FROM "${cur_database}"."${cur_table}"
WHERE line_item_line_item_type = 'Usage' AND line_item_usage_type LIKE '%VolumeUsage%' AND $__timeFilter(line_item_usage_start_date)
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 3 DESC

panels.title: EBS snapshot usage
panels.description: SnapshotUsage in GB-month; this is storage usage, never a recovery-point count.

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT line_item_usage_type AS usage_type, pricing_unit AS unit, SUM(CAST(line_item_usage_amount AS double)) AS gb_month
FROM "${cur_database}"."${cur_table}"
WHERE line_item_line_item_type = 'Usage' AND (line_item_usage_type LIKE '%SnapshotUsage%' OR line_item_usage_type LIKE '%SnapUsage%') AND $__timeFilter(line_item_usage_start_date)
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 3 DESC

panels.title: VPC Interface Endpoint usage
panels.description: The current S3 Gateway Endpoint is free and does not appear here. Interface endpoint hours/data usage is shown as 0 when no corresponding CUR usage exists.

targets.rawSQL:
WITH endpoint_usage AS (
 SELECT line_item_usage_type AS usage_type, pricing_unit AS unit, SUM(CAST(line_item_usage_amount AS double)) AS usage_amount
 FROM "${cur_database}"."${cur_table}"
 WHERE line_item_line_item_type = 'Usage' AND line_item_usage_type LIKE '%VpcEndpoint%' AND $__timeFilter(line_item_usage_start_date)
 GROUP BY 1,2
)
SELECT usage_type, unit, usage_amount FROM endpoint_usage
UNION ALL SELECT 'No Interface Endpoint usage', 'GB/Hrs', 0.0 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM endpoint_usage)
ORDER BY 3 DESC

panels.title: Telemetry export volume
panels.description: Exporter records per second. This is the evidence for sampling/cardinality decisions without disabling observability.

panels.title: 4. Top Non-Compute Cost Drivers — normalised list-price equivalent
Total estimated non-compute cost
panels.description: Sum of the normalised list-price equivalents in the table. This is not the credit-masked invoice total.

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT SUM(CAST(line_item_usage_amount AS double) * CASE
 WHEN line_item_usage_type LIKE '%NatGateway-Hours%' THEN 0.045
 WHEN line_item_usage_type LIKE '%NatGateway-Bytes%' THEN 0.045
 WHEN line_item_usage_type LIKE '%DataTransfer-xAZ-%' THEN 0.020
 WHEN line_item_usage_type LIKE '%VolumeUsage.gp3%' THEN 0.080
 WHEN line_item_usage_type LIKE '%SnapshotUsage%' OR line_item_usage_type LIKE '%SnapUsage%' THEN 0.050
 WHEN line_item_usage_type LIKE '%VpcEndpoint-Hours%' THEN 0.010
 WHEN line_item_usage_type LIKE '%VpcEndpoint-Bytes%' THEN 0.010 ELSE 0 END) AS estimated_usd
FROM "${cur_database}"."${cur_table}"
WHERE line_item_line_item_type = 'Usage' AND $__timeFilter(line_item_usage_start_date)

panels.title: Top non-compute cost drivers
panels.description: Each CUR usage type is multiplied by the corresponding us-east-1 list price. This normalises GB, GB-month and hours into USD equivalent. Billing credits may mask invoice cost; this panel is a comparable usage-based estimate.

targets.rawSQL:
WITH drivers AS (
 SELECT CASE
   WHEN line_item_usage_type LIKE '%NatGateway-Hours%' THEN 'NAT Gateway active time'
   WHEN line_item_usage_type LIKE '%NatGateway-Bytes%' THEN 'NAT Gateway data processed'
   WHEN line_item_usage_type LIKE '%DataTransfer-xAZ-%' THEN 'Cross-AZ data transfer'
   WHEN line_item_usage_type LIKE '%VolumeUsage.gp3%' THEN 'EBS gp3 storage'
   WHEN line_item_usage_type LIKE '%SnapshotUsage%' OR line_item_usage_type LIKE '%SnapUsage%' THEN 'EBS snapshot storage'
   WHEN line_item_usage_type LIKE '%VpcEndpoint-Hours%' THEN 'VPC Interface Endpoint active time'
   WHEN line_item_usage_type LIKE '%VpcEndpoint-Bytes%' THEN 'VPC Interface Endpoint data processed' END AS driver,
   pricing_unit AS usage_unit, SUM(CAST(line_item_usage_amount AS double)) AS usage_amount
 FROM "${cur_database}"."${cur_table}"
 WHERE line_item_line_item_type = 'Usage' AND $__timeFilter(line_item_usage_start_date)
  AND (line_item_usage_type LIKE '%NatGateway-Hours%' OR line_item_usage_type LIKE '%NatGateway-Bytes%' OR line_item_usage_type LIKE '%DataTransfer-xAZ-%' OR line_item_usage_type LIKE '%VolumeUsage.gp3%' OR line_item_usage_type LIKE '%SnapshotUsage%' OR line_item_usage_type LIKE '%SnapUsage%' OR line_item_usage_type LIKE '%VpcEndpoint%')
 GROUP BY 1,2
), priced AS (
 SELECT driver, usage_unit, usage_amount, CASE
   WHEN driver = 'NAT Gateway active time' THEN 0.045
   WHEN driver = 'NAT Gateway data processed' THEN 0.045
   WHEN driver = 'Cross-AZ data transfer' THEN 0.020
   WHEN driver = 'EBS gp3 storage' THEN 0.080
   WHEN driver = 'EBS snapshot storage' THEN 0.050
   WHEN driver = 'VPC Interface Endpoint active time' THEN 0.010
   WHEN driver = 'VPC Interface Endpoint data processed' THEN 0.010 END AS list_price_usd_per_unit
 FROM drivers WHERE driver IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT driver, usage_unit, usage_amount, list_price_usd_per_unit, usage_amount * list_price_usd_per_unit AS estimated_usd
FROM priced
UNION ALL SELECT 'VPC Interface Endpoint active time', 'Hrs', 0.0, 0.010, 0.0 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM priced WHERE driver = 'VPC Interface Endpoint active time')
UNION ALL SELECT 'VPC Interface Endpoint data processed', 'GB', 0.0, 0.010, 0.0 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM priced WHERE driver = 'VPC Interface Endpoint data processed')
ORDER BY estimated_usd DESC
